source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-24

procedures.title: Standard Corvette steering column: disassemble
steps: Slide the upper end assembly and covers off the column end.
If the upper end parts need service, remove the turn signal switch mounting screws and lift the switch and upper bearing housing out of the cover.
Ease the steering shaft assembly out of the lower end of the mast jacket.
If needed, remove the lower bearing assembly from the jacket's lower end and throw it away.
Remove the flange bolt and flange from the shaft.
Slide the lower bearing spring, plunger and sleeve assembly, and thrust washer off the shaft.
If needed, remove the 2 seals from the inside of the jacket's lower end.
If needed, unwrap the mesh cover from the jacket.

procedures.title: Standard Corvette steering column: assemble
steps: Lightly coat all friction surfaces with lithium soap grease.
If the lower-end seals were removed, cement 2 new ones in place inside the jacket.
If the lower bearing was removed, press a new one into the lower end of the jacket.
From the top of the shaft, slide on the thrust washer, wave washer, packing seal, spacer, clamp bolt and nut, plunger and spring.
Fit the flange and flange bolt to the shaft's lower end.
Carefully slide the shaft into the lower end of the jacket.
Assemble the upper bearing housing and turn signal switch into the cover, and fasten the whole unit to the jacket upper flange with the 3 signal switch screws (see figure 48 in the manual).
Route the turn signal switch wires through the upper assembly.
Bolt the upper flange to the column with its 3 mounting bolts.
Place the wave washer, thrust washer and C ring loosely at the top of the shaft.
Seat the C ring with snap ring installer J-22659, making sure it is fully in the shaft groove.
Fit the turn signal lever with its screw and screw in the hazard warning knob.
Lay the switch wires flat along the column, fit the wiring protector, and slide the covers into place.
If removed, wrap the mesh cover around the jacket's mesh section and secure it with electrical or friction tape.
Fit the spring and cancelling cam on the shaft end.

procedures.title: Corvette telescoping steering column: disassemble
steps: Lay the column on a suitable bench (see figure 49 in the manual for the exploded view).
Take the upper bearing preload spring and cancelling cam off the shaft end.
Remove the turn signal lever screw and lever; push in, unscrew and remove the hazard warning knob.
Pry the upper spiral retaining ring off the upper shaft with a screwdriver (see figure 50 in the manual); remove the thrust and wave washers.
Remove the 3 lower bearing retainer screws.
Ease the shaft assembly out of the jacket's lower end.
Remove the flange bolt and flange from the shaft's lower end.
Scribe the clamp so it can go back in the same radial and axial position; unwrap the mesh cover if needed.
Remove the clamp, bolt, nut, spacer, spring, washer, packing washer and bearing; use the notched groove on the shaft to lever the bearing off with a screwdriver.
